cases.reason: Japanese forms separate the family and given name with an ideographic space.
cases.fix: Split on U+3000 as well as U+0020, and take the FIRST token as the family name.

cases.reason: The same name with an ASCII space.
cases.fix: Both separators must produce the same split.

cases.reason: A foreign resident's name in katakana, separated by a middle dot.
cases.fix: Treat U+30FB and U+FF65 as name separators.

cases.reason: An unspaced kanji name cannot be segmented without a name dictionary — 田中/太郎 and 田/中太郎 are both readable. Guessing puts the wrong name on an invoice.
cases.fix: Return the value whole rather than splitting at a fixed offset. Collect family and given in separate inputs if you need them separated.

cases.reason: Half-width input must be normalized before splitting, not after.
cases.fix: Normalize width first; otherwise the stored parts keep the half-width form.

cases.reason: Japanese name order is family first. Rendering 太郎 山田 is visibly wrong.
cases.fix: Do not reuse a `${given} ${family}` template for Japanese locales.

cases.reason: The Western ordering of the same record, for an English-language document.
cases.fix: Make the order a formatting decision, not a storage decision.

cases.reason: A customer who signed up as 高橋太郎 and later types 髙橋 太郎 must resolve to the same account, not a duplicate.
cases.fix: Build a comparison key: fold variants, unify kana, strip separators, lower-case.

cases.reason: The baseline form the previous case must collapse onto.
cases.fix: Same key function.

cases.reason: Half-width input must produce the same key as full-width.
cases.fix: Normalize width inside the key function.

cases.reason: A hiragana reading and a katakana reading of the same name must share a key, or every customer who switches IME mode becomes a duplicate.
cases.fix: Unify kana to one script inside the key function.

cases.reason: Normalization fixes encoding, never spelling. Writing the folded form back to the name field renames the customer.
cases.fix: Keep folding out of the storage path; fold only when building a comparison key.
